decisions.reason: The Android requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the reusable-background and translatable-text strategy.
The tutorial image strategy was already established by message 46; message 49 confirms it without changing the candidate's state.
Separating tutorial text from reusable backgrounds is an asset and size strategy, not a change to the existing requirement to localize the full iOS app.
The reusable tutorial-background strategy does not change the requirement for correct right-to-left layout behavior.
The tutorial asset strategy does not alter iOS framework modernization, deprecated API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The localized-image decision has no effect on the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
Rendering tutorial text through localization supports implementation but does not change the existing scope or validity of full-app Android localization.
The tutorial asset strategy is unrelated to renewal or validity of the iOS signing configuration.
The localized tutorial asset decision does not change Android platform compatibility, deprecated API refactoring, or maintainability requirements.
The reusable-background strategy has no effect on the policy to remove unused Android permissions or the identified READ_PHONE_STATE permission.
